title: Playing for a film at the St. Charles Hotel
summary: Williams recalls the band making movie footage for overseas visitors and priests at the St. Charles Hotel, where Bunk explained the origin of the tailgate trombone in the African jungle.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Back to Bump, before I forget it, didn't you all play at the St. Charles Hotel there?
Yeah we made moving pitches for boys overseas.
Do you remember those guys there? Was it a party or what?
No, they had a lot of people came from overseas.

With the priests. The priests came with them too. And they wanted to know where the Taggart was originated from. So Bunker explained them where the Taggart was originated from. The Taggart was originated from the Afrikas in the jungle.
you know? It was all being the jungle's island. And that's where the Taggart was originated from, from the Afrikas in the jungle.
